# dodopayments_product_collection (Resource)

Manages a product collection.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dodopayments_addon" "example" {
  currency     = "USD"
  name         = "example-addon"
  price        = 100
  tax_category = "digital_products"
}

resource "dodopayments_credit_entitlement" "example" {
  currency         = "USD"
  name             = "example-credit-entitlement"
  overage_enabled  = false
  precision        = 2
  price_per_unit   = "10.5"
  rollover_enabled = false
  unit             = "credits"
}

resource "dodopayments_entitlement" "example" {
  integration_config = {
    feature_id   = "example-entitlement"
    feature_type = "boolean"
  }
  integration_type = "feature_flag"
  metadata = {
    tier = "pro"
  }
  name = "example-entitlement"
}

resource "dodopayments_product" "example" {
  addons = [dodopayments_addon.example.id]
  credit_entitlements = [{
    credit_entitlement_id = dodopayments_credit_entitlement.example.id
    credits_amount        = "100.0"
  }]
  entitlements = [{
    entitlement_id = dodopayments_entitlement.example.id
  }]
  metadata = {
    plan = "pro"
  }
  name = "example-product"
  price = {
    type                         = "recurring_price"
    currency                     = "USD"
    price                        = 1000
    payment_frequency_count      = 1
    payment_frequency_interval   = "Month"
    subscription_period_count    = 1
    subscription_period_interval = "Year"
  }
  pricing_mode = "by_currency"
  tax_category = "saas"
}

resource "dodopayments_product_collection" "example" {
  groups = [{
    products = [{
      product_id = dodopayments_product.example.id
    }]
  }]
  name = "example-product-collection"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `groups` (Attributes List) Groups of products in this collection. A change to this value destroys the resource and creates a new resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups))
- `name` (String) Name of the product collection.

### Optional

- `brand_id` (String) Brand id for the collection, if not provided will default to primary brand. If you remove this attribute from the configuration, the API keeps the last value.
- `description` (String) Optional description of the product collection.
- `effective_at_on_downgrade` (String) Default effective_at setting for subscription plan downgrades (NULL = inherit from business).
- `effective_at_on_upgrade` (String) Default effective_at setting for subscription plan upgrades (NULL = inherit from business).
- `on_payment_failure` (String) Default behavior for subscription plan changes on payment failure (NULL = inherit from business).
- `proration_billing_mode_on_downgrade` (String) Default proration billing mode for subscription plan downgrades (NULL = inherit from business).
- `proration_billing_mode_on_upgrade` (String) Default proration billing mode for subscription plan upgrades (NULL = inherit from business).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the collection was created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the product collection.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the collection was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `groups`

Required:

- `products` (Attributes List) Products in this group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups--products))

Optional:

- `group_name` (String) Optional group name. Multiple groups can have null names, but named groups must be unique per collection. If you remove this attribute from the configuration, the API keeps the last value.
- `status` (Boolean) Status of the group (defaults to true if not provided). If you remove this attribute from the configuration, the API keeps the last value.

Read-Only:

- `group_id` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--groups--products"></a>
### Nested Schema for `groups.products`

Required:

- `product_id` (String) Product ID to include in the group.

Optional:

- `status` (Boolean) Status of the product in this group (defaults to true if not provided). If you remove this attribute from the configuration, the API keeps the last value.

Read-Only:

- `addons_count` (Number)
- `currency` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `files_count` (Number)
- `has_credit_entitlements` (Boolean) Whether this product has any credit entitlements attached.
- `id` (String)
- `is_recurring` (Boolean)
- `license_key_enabled` (Boolean)
- `meters_count` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `price` (Number)
- `price_detail` (String) One-time price details.
- `tax_category` (String) Represents the different categories of taxation applicable to various products and services.
- `tax_inclusive` (Boolean)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = dodopayments_product_collection.example
  identity = {
    id = "<id>"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) The ID of the product collection.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = dodopayments_product_collection.example
  id = "<id>"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a product collection by its ID.
terraform import dodopayments_product_collection.example <id>
```
